title: Async functions should not contain synchronous HTTP client calls
description: This rule detects when asynchronous functions (those defined with `async def`) contain synchronous HTTP client calls (like `requests.get()`, `urllib.request.urlopen()`, etc.). Mixing synchronous I/O operations in async functions can block the event loop, negating the performance benefits of async/await and potentially causing application hangs or timeouts. Async functions should use async-compatible HTTP clients like `aiohttp` or `httpx` instead.
message: Replace this synchronous HTTP call with an async alternative (e.g., 'aiohttp' or 'httpx') to avoid blocking the event loop.
